evidence.quote: Grow is an independent canalside cafe, bar, kitchen and grassroots music venue on the River Lea, serving Hackney Wick since 2014.
CANALSIDE CAFE, BAR, KITCHEN AND LIVE MUSIC VENUE IN HACKNEY WICK
JAZZ JAM WITH STRATOS // EVERY THURSDAY
SHEDDING HISTORIES: JAWA JONES // BROR HAVNES // MIMIKA (FUNK, PSYCH, JAZZ, DISCO)
DEEPDIG: HANDSON FAMILY // VANESSA FREEMAN (DISCO, FUNK, SOUL, BROKEN BEAT, HOUSE)
DEEPDIG: MARSHMELLO // KANEM (SOUL, JAZZ, BROKEN BEAT, HOUSE)

findings.value: Mostly live and DJ nights: a weekly Thursday jazz jam run by a resident band since 2016, free weekend afternoon canalside sessions of live music, rare groove and funk DJ parties that have run at Grow for over four years, a monthly Sunday evening open jam, and DeepDig nights of long DJ sets.

evidence.quote: Since 2016, Stratos, our resident jazz band led by the talented and Mercury Prize-nominated Rio Kai, has held down this popular night
Join us canalside at Grow in Hackney Wick every Saturday and Sunday from 1-4pm for an afternoon of free live music
Running parties at Grow for over 4 years they specialise in psychedelic and cosmic sounds
At DeepDig, we bring our favourite DJs to play the sets they don’t usually get to play at bigger venues or festivals.
